+extern "C" void c_swap_out(natl pid, char *buf)
+{
+    // Troja check: buf must be accessible and writable in user shared memory
+    if (!c_access(buf, DIM_USR_STACK, true)) {
+        c_abort_p();
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // pid must be valid
+    if (pid > MAX_PROC_ID || !proc_table[pid]) {
+        esecuzione->contesto[I_RAX] = false;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    des_proc* p = proc_table[pid];
+
+    // Can't swap out system process
+    if (p->livello == LIV_SISTEMA) {
+        c_abort_p();
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Can't swap out self
+    if (p == esecuzione) {
+        c_abort_p();
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Already swapped out
+    if (p->swapped_out) {
+        esecuzione->contesto[I_RAX] = false;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Copy user stack from P2 to buffer via FM window
+    // User stack is at [fin_utn_p - DIM_USR_STACK, fin_utn_p)
+    for (vaddr v = fin_utn_p - DIM_USR_STACK; v < fin_utn_p; v += DIM_PAGINA) {
+        paddr phys = trasforma(p->cr3, v);
+        natq offset = v - (fin_utn_p - DIM_USR_STACK);
+        if (phys) {
+            memcpy(buf + offset, reinterpret_cast<char*>(phys), DIM_PAGINA);
+        } else {
+            memset(buf + offset, 0, DIM_PAGINA);
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Destroy user stack (unmap and deallocate frames)
+    distruggi_pila(p->cr3, fin_utn_p, DIM_USR_STACK);
+
+    p->swapped_out = true;
+    esecuzione->contesto[I_RAX] = true;
+}
+
+extern "C" void c_swap_in(natl pid, const char *buf)
+{
+    // Troja check: buf must be accessible in user shared memory
+    if (!c_access(buf, DIM_USR_STACK, false)) {
+        c_abort_p();
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // pid must be valid
+    if (pid > MAX_PROC_ID || !proc_table[pid]) {
+        esecuzione->contesto[I_RAX] = false;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    des_proc* p = proc_table[pid];
+
+    // Can't swap in system process
+    if (p->livello == LIV_SISTEMA) {
+        c_abort_p();
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Must be swapped out
+    if (!p->swapped_out) {
+        esecuzione->contesto[I_RAX] = false;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Create user stack with new frames
+    if (!crea_pila(p->cr3, fin_utn_p, DIM_USR_STACK, LIV_UTENTE)) {
+        esecuzione->contesto[I_RAX] = false;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Copy buffer to new stack via FM window
+    for (vaddr v = fin_utn_p - DIM_USR_STACK; v < fin_utn_p; v += DIM_PAGINA) {
+        paddr phys = trasforma(p->cr3, v);
+        natq offset = v - (fin_utn_p - DIM_USR_STACK);
+        memcpy(reinterpret_cast<char*>(phys), buf + offset, DIM_PAGINA);
+    }
+
+    p->swapped_out = false;
+
+    // If the process was scheduled while swapped out, reinsert in ready queue
+    if (p->scheduled) {
+        p->scheduled = false;
+        inserimento_lista(pronti, p);
+    }
+
+    esecuzione->contesto[I_RAX] = true;
+}
